lines.en: She sent the chicken back again?
She said it's too dry now, and she wants to come back here
and explain to you exactly how she wants it.
Well, fine. I'd like to meet this chicken expert.
Janice, how are you, Miss Hotshot Chef
at the big fancy restaurant with the best chicken ever?
Oh, what is that on your finger? I'm blind!
You didn't tell her we're getting married, did you?
Well, she was shocked when I told her,
but then again, so were most people.
Well, she actually has a boyfriend of, you know, herself.
Uh, she also kind of invited herself to her wedding.
She asked me if the wedding was in town.
I mean, what was I supposed to do?
Oh, your baby is so cute.
I can't wait to read your book, Ross.
So she comes to the wedding.
I mean, it won't be so bad.
What, do you think she's just gonna sit there quietly?
You don't think she's gonna want to make a toast?
You don't think she's gonna want to grab the microphone
She's not gonna like the chicken that night, either, is she?
She's probably not gonna even want to come.
Wouldn't it really been that easy?
Good. So do it Saturday night, because we're going to dinner with her and Clark.
